children: Chennai: Auto parts conglomerate Samvardhana Motherson plans to invest about 11,000 crore over the next five years, along with its European and UK-based joint venture companies, to establish design, engineering, manufacturing, assembly and logistics facilities in Tamil Nadu.

The company Monday signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the state government for the investment that's expected to create about 7,000 jobs. The MoU was signed in London in the presence of visiting Tamil Nadu chief minister C Joseph Vijay. This is the first major investment announcement after Vijay arrived in the UK capital as part of his visit aimed at attracting investments and expanding partnerships in sectors including advanced manufacturing, electric vehicles, electronics and global capability centres.- Our Bureau

title: Motherson, JV Cos Look to Invest 11,000 cr in TN, Create 7,000 Jobs
